answer: Track correlated downtime. Every identity sends a signed heartbeat each minute, and the ledger keeps a trellis of who was offline when. Independent operators drop out at unrelated times, but a farm on one box or one link vanishes together whenever it reboots or its network fails, and those shared failures can't be scheduled away. Over a 30-epoch horizon, identities whose outage minutes overlap above 90% are pooled into one reward and one vote. To stay separate, each fake needs its own power and network, so the voyage of a sybil swarm ends as a single share.
